about: Place names the player is told (ink UI round, gen/ui/STYLE.md 'Place notifications'). region: the large banner shown when you walk into this section's region (sections sharing a region id show it once). landmarks: a vertical name plaque stands over the map entity id as you approach (江南百景圖's plaques), and a toast with the line from the painting's reading when you come within r metres of its footprint (or its point); top: the plaque's height when the map has none. Every name and line in 繁體, from the painting and its readings; src says where. Lore (round 2, gen/ui/r2_lore.md): long is the longer description under the toast's fold and in the 圖志 journal; quote and quoteSrc an exact line from a period or scholarly source; cite the sources as the player reads them; longSrc one note per claim (never shown); crop the map IDs that frame the painting's crop (tools/place_crops.mjs). Bundled for the page by tools/ui_data.mjs into web/public/assets/ui/places.json (short) and lore.json (long, fetched when needed). Every displayed field has an English sibling `<field>_en`, shown as a gloss under the Chinese when the viewer picks 中英 (Chinese stays the default).

region.name: 卷尾
region.src: map/sections.json S7 '卷尾 · 赵太丞家'; 余辉《深度游》第七段 結尾 (reference/scroll/sections.md §1.2)
region.long: 長卷到此收束。余輝說，畫家在結尾留下「三問」：趙太丞家門前問病，「解」字招牌下問命，官宦人家門口問道。街上一位戴寬簷帽的官人騎馬出行；提著食盒的外鄉人順著守門人的手指望去，兩旁街樹相合，畫卷卻戛然而止。徐邦達疑心「後面是割去了不少的」，鄭振鐸以為原畫應一直畫到金明池。畫後接著的，是金、元、明歷代文人的題跋。
region.long_en: Here the long scroll draws to a close. Yu Hui says the painter leaves “three questions” at the end: asking about illness before Imperial Physician Zhao's door, asking about fate under the sign of the character “Jie,” and asking the way at the door of an official family. An official in a wide-brimmed hat rides out along the street; a stranger carrying a food box follows the gatekeeper's pointing finger, the street trees on both sides close together, and the painting simply stops. Xu Bangda suspects that “a good deal was cut off after this,” and Zheng Zhenduo thought the original ran all the way to the Jinming Pond. After the painting come the colophons of scholars of the Jin, Yuan and Ming dynasties.
region.quote: 翰林張擇端，字正道，東武人也。幼讀書，遊學於京師。
region.quote_en: The Hanlin academician Zhang Zeduan, courtesy name Zhengdao, was a man of Dongwu. As a boy he read books and went to study in the capital.
region.cite: 余輝〈最後三問〉・故宮名畫記・徐邦達・鄭振鐸
region.cite_en: Yu Hui, The Last Three Questions · Palace Museum, Minghuaji · Xu Bangda · Zheng Zhenduo
longSrc: YH21: 问病、问命、问道 (赵太丞家, the 解 sign, the official gatehouse)
MHJ 49: 手提着食盒…看门人很热心给他指路…两侧街树相合，朦胧一片，画卷却在这里戛然而止
SEC §1.3: 徐邦达 1958 "我疑心后面是割去了不少的"; 郑振铎 thought it should run on to 金明池
COL: the colophons of the Jin, Yuan and Ming after the painting

landmarks.name: 趙太丞家
landmarks.line: 門前招牌：治酒所傷真方集香丸。
landmarks.line_en: The sign: a true remedy, Incense Pills, for wine-sickness.
landmarks.src: 名画记 48 国医赵太丞家; the painted signboards (S7.prop.board_zhao_*)
landmarks.long: 水井旁又是一家醫鋪，簷下幾塊菱形牌子寫著「趙太丞家」，故宮稱它「國醫趙太丞家」；余輝說趙太丞是侍奉過宮廷的太醫。鋪裏一位穿深色長袍的醫者伸手察看孩子，婦人抱著孩子來求醫。門前立著幾塊高大的招牌，故宮能讀全的一塊寫著「治酒所傷真方集香丸」，柱上一牌還認得出「五勞七傷」。前頭正店、腳店顧客盈門，喝傷了的人想必不少。余輝把這裏讀作結尾「三問」的問病。
landmarks.long_en: Beside the well is another medicine shop, with several diamond-shaped boards under the eaves reading “Zhao Taicheng's House”; the Palace Museum calls it the house of “the national physician Zhao Taicheng,” and Yu Hui says Zhao was an imperial doctor who had served the court. Inside, a doctor in a dark robe reaches out to examine a child, and a woman holds the child in to be treated. Out front stand several tall signs; the one the Palace Museum can read in full says “True remedy, Incense Pills, for harm done by wine,” and on a pillar one board still reads “The Five Strains and Seven Injuries.” The taverns ahead are full of customers, so there must have been many who drank too much. Yu Hui reads this as the question about illness among the closing “three questions.”
landmarks.cite: 故宮名畫記・余輝〈最後三問〉・畫中所見
landmarks.cite_en: Palace Museum, Minghuaji · Yu Hui, The Last Three Questions · What the painting shows
longSrc: map S7.bld.zhao_taicheng: four lozenge-shaped tablets 趙·太·丞·家; a board on the west column 五勞七傷□□□
MHJ 48 国医赵太丞家: 门面里有柜台…"治酒所伤真方集香丸"…豪华的"正店"和"脚店"顾客盈门，可见当时喝酒成风，受酒伤的人也一定不少
YH21 问病: 这个"赵太丞"，可是一位侍奉宋廷的太医…专治"五劳七伤"

landmarks.name: 官宦人家
landmarks.line_en: At the gatehouse, someone asks the way.
landmarks.src: 名画记 49 官宦人家; 余辉 2014 vignette 门房指路
landmarks.long: 趙太丞家隔壁是一座深宅大院，門屋簷下有斗拱，門前有上馬石，看得出是官宦人家。一個外鄉人提著食盒、背著大包袱，在門前停步問路，門口的人伸手往西一指。故宮名畫記寫道：順著他指的方向望去，只見兩旁街樹相合，朦朧一片，畫卷卻在這裏戛然而止。余輝把這一幕讀作結尾「三問」的問道：畫家也在問，這個國家該往哪裏走。
landmarks.long_en: Next to Zhao's is a deep courtyard house with brackets under the gatehouse eaves and a mounting stone by the door, plainly the home of an official family. A stranger with a food box in his hand and a large bundle on his back stops at the door to ask the way, and the man at the gate points west. The Palace Museum's notes write: follow where he points and you see the street trees on both sides closing together in a haze, and the painting ends right there. Yu Hui reads this as the question about the way among the closing “three questions”: the painter is also asking where the country should go.
landmarks.cite: 故宮名畫記・余輝〈最後三問〉・畫中所見
landmarks.cite_en: Palace Museum, Minghuaji · Yu Hui, The Last Three Questions · What the painting shows
longSrc: MHJ 49: 门屋檐下的斗拱和门前的上马石，都显示出这是一户官宦人家…手提着食盒，肩上背着一个大包袱…看门人很热心给他指路…两侧街树相合，朦胧一片，画卷却在这里戛然而止
YH21 问道: 画家也表达了他希望能够有一条救治国家的道路
